thread:
Tara P: quick microcheck — pushed a small set of fixes to the SDK quickstart samples for Node + Python. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-samples/pull/412. Fixed Mac M1 install steps and clarified python venv activation. Blocker: Windows CI failing on `npm run build` (node-gyp).
Liam H: looking now, thanks. quick q — did you bump `package.json` engines? that's probably causing some CI mismatch.
Tara P: not yet, wanted to keep the change minimal. also added a tiny README snippet showing KMS env var usage.
Ashley K: I can take the Windows CI tomorrow — assign to me. suspect we just need `windows-build-tools` and a few workflow tweaks. :thumbsup:
Raj P: heads up — i'm about to land a docs change that updates the quickstart endpoint names; tests might need re-gen after that.
Tara P: awesome. @Ashley K pls push a commit to the PR and tag me, i'll re-run the sample smoke. also need a one-line changelog blurb: 'fix: cross-platform install steps'
Ashley K: on it. i'll add a note about `--legacy-peer-deps` in troubleshooting too.
docs-bot: Reminder: docs deployment scheduled for 03:00 UTC. If any doclink changes are in your PRs, add the `hold-deploy` label.
Liam H: small nit — python sample pins `requests==2.28.1`. Can we relax to `requests>=2.28` so we don't block security patches?
Tara P: good catch, i'll update that in the PR.
Ashley K: pushed a tiny CI fix on my fork — windows workflow now passes. updated PR with commit `fix/windows-ci-413a`.
Tara P: merged, thanks both. re-running local smoke. Plan for today: finish the changelog blurb, update `package.json` engines, merge remaining PRs, and scrub README to ensure no real tokens are in examples.
Raj P: blocked on the test re-gen until the PR lands, i'll rebase and run after you merge.
Tara P: will merge in ~15-30m. ping here if anything else pops up.
Liam H: left a tiny review comment on the python snippet for formatting.
Ashley K: added that formatting fix in a follow-up commit.
Tara P: all set from my side. thanks! :pray:
